newsitem.title: ITALY: Four short-listed for Seat stake - paper.
newsitem.headline: Four short-listed for Seat stake - paper.

text.p: Four groupings have been short-listed by the Italian Treasury for a possible bid for IRI's stake in Italian telephone director publishing group Seat, the Milan financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore reported.

The paper said that four groupings had been short-listed for consideration in an offer for the 61 percent stake still held by state industrial group IRI. Seat was floated off from state-controlled telecoms group STET at the beginning of this year with IRI holding a 61 percent stake.
A STET spokesman declined comment on Monday on the short-list report with appeared in Il Sole at the weekend.
The paper listed U.S. group telecom group GTE Corp and ITT Corp, a consortium lead by Dutch bank ABN AMRO with Italian partners, and an Italian consortium group of De Agostini-L'Espresso-Comit.
In December, IRI said that it had received eight non-binding offers for Seat from 21 individual bodies. Seat publishes yellow pages telephone directories in Italy.
